notes: Round 3 (puppets_r3, 1.5M decisions): surviving is learned. The deer feed 74% of the time, the store stays at 0.96, four in five die of old age after 800 s in the world. Still not one conception: Mate mode is at 2%, Feed at 83%. The court term paid 0.003 a decision for standing within 100 m of the other sex, which the deer collected while grazing; it never told them to come closer (0.00006 a metre). Round 4: eating pays only under 0.85 of a store, so a fed deer has nothing to gain from grass; courting pays by the metre it comes closer (the new mate_closing signal) and for staying within 10 m; pairing and conceiving pay more. Fear pays by the metre too.

terms.name: graze
terms.expr: 0.004 * step(0.8 - energy) * mode_feed * step(grass_here - 0.1) * max(0, 1 - muzzle_height)

terms.name: pair
terms.expr: 0.05 * adult * (1 - pregnant) * step(energy - 0.5) * mode_mate * step(3 - mate_distance)
